name: Assurant Inc
summary:
Assurant (AIZ) reported earnings of $6.41 per share on revenue of $3.45 billion for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $5.16 per share on revenue of $3.40 billion. The company beat consensus estimates by 24.22% while revenue grew 9.37% on a year-over-year basis.

Assurant Inc is a provider of specialized insurance products and related services in North America and selected other international markets.
subject: Assurant Beat Consensus Estimates
